name: Elda Finis Victoria
original_name: エルダ＝フィニス＝ヴィクトリア
source:
[url=/c12399]Seera Finis Victoria[/url]'s mother and headmaster of Fortia Magic Academy. She has a sassy personality, and she manages to be friendly with her students without giving away their respect for her position as headmaster.
